You may choose to either delete or deactivate your account.

Deactivation will make your account inactive. Should you want to reactivate your account, you just need to login to SocaLoca and your account will be restored.

SocaLoca is the football app that tracks and supports your footballing career regardless of your level of play!

Create your player profile, track your career and playing statistics, upload videos and photos, jump into a pick-up match, join a team or find new teams to play against, engage in tournaments and competitions within your local community.
